item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The figure shows Chitra's bar graph of games played on three days. The vertical scale uses equal intervals.

Which day has the greatest number of games?

options.A: Monday, reading bar width instead of bar height on the numerical scale.
options.B: Tuesday, because its bar is tallest on the equal-interval scale.
options.C: Wednesday, comparing bars as if the vertical scale need not use equal intervals.
options.D: Monday, because that bar is shaded darker and decoration settles the value.
